summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Travel Animator app. All core features working perfectly including landing page animations, map functionality, destination search, route visualization, transport selection, and route animation. Mobile responsiveness excellent across all features.
passed_tests: Landing page animation - circular icons fit within page (280px/350px circle)
Landing page - curved plane animation flies separately from circle icons
Landing page - no center icon in circle, title displayed in center
Map default zoom - correctly centered on USA (lat ~39, lng ~-98)
Destination search - typing city and pressing Enter successfully adds destinations
Route visualization - curved route lines appear after adding 2+ destinations
Map zoom to first destination - automatically zooms to first added destination
Transport selector - all 4 transport modes (plane/car/train/walk) clickable with visual feedback
Play button - appears when 2+ destinations added and starts route animation
Route animation - transport icon animates smoothly along curved route path
Pause button - successfully pauses animation when clicked
Progress bar - shows animation progress during route playback
Destination list - displays journey with numbered destinations and remove functionality
Remove destination - successfully removes destinations and updates route
Mobile responsiveness (390x844) - all features work perfectly on mobile
Mobile UI layout - search box and transport selector fit within viewport
Mobile animations - landing page and route animations work on mobile
Toast notifications - success messages for adding destinations and completing journey
OpenStreetMap integration - Nominatim geocoding API working correctly
Leaflet map integration - smooth map interactions and marker display
